div.div: صَدْحَةٌ (S, L, K) and ↓ صُدْحَةٌ and ↓ صَدَحَةٌ (L, K) A kind of bead (خَرَزَةٌ, Lh, S, L, K) used for the purpose of captivating, or fascinating: (K:) or with which men are captivated, or fascinated: (S:) or with which women captivate, or fascinate, men: (Lh:) or with which men are conciliated. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
